           BEFORE THE CORPORATION COMMISSION OF THE STATE OF OKLAHOMA

          IN THE MATTER OF THE APPLICATION OF                         )
          OKLAHOMA GAS AND ELECTRIC COMPANY                           ) Case No. PUD2026-000031
          FOR COMMISSION APPROVAL OF ELECTRIC                         )
          SERVICE AGREEMENTS AND PREAPPROVAL                          )
          OF CAPACITY PURCHASE AGREEMENTS                             )
          PURSUANT 17 O.S. § 286(C)                                   )


                     OKLAHOMA GAS AND ELECTRIC COMPANY’S EXHIBIT LIST

                 COMES NOW Oklahoma Gas and Electric Company (“OG&E” or the “Company”) and

         pursuant to Order No. 758317 (Order Granting Motion for Procedural Order), and submits the

         following list of exhibits OG&E may present or rely upon at the Hearing on the Merits in this

         Case:

                 1. All documents filed with the Oklahoma Corporation Commission Court Clerk and
                    contained in the docket in this Case.
                 2. All testimony filed or exchanged in this Case (whether Confidential or Redacted),
                    including testimony exhibits, schedules, workpapers, and supporting documentation
                    cited by testimony or data request responses.
                 3. All Data Requests and Reponses, including any attachments thereto, submitted by any
                    party in this proceeding.
                 4. All statutes, rules, cases, and regulatory decisions or orders that deal with any
                    substantive legal, technical, policy, or other issue that arises in this proceeding,
                    including but not limited to 17 O.S. § 286 and OAC 165:35-34, 37, and 38.
                 5. Any publicly disclosed information relating to any issues raised in this proceeding,
                    including, but not limited to, public information relating to this case.
                 6. Exhibits necessary or helpful in supporting cross-examination or any oral surrebuttal
                    testimony offered in this case by OG&E.
                 7. All exhibits listed by any other party to this Case.
                 8. Any other exhibits agreed to by the parties and approved by the Administrative Law
                    Judge.
